name: tinycast-caffeinate
title: Caffeinate
description: Keep your Mac awake with caffeinate: display off, system only, or while a process runs.
author: romainbsl

commands.name: caffeinate-display-off
commands.title: Caffeinate — Display Off
commands.subtitle: Caffeinate
commands.description: Keeps the Mac awake and turns the display off right away.

commands.name: caffeinate-system
commands.title: Caffeinate — Keep Awake
commands.subtitle: Caffeinate
commands.description: Prevents system sleep; the display follows its usual settings.

commands.name: caffeinate-while
commands.title: Caffeinate — While Process Runs
commands.subtitle: Caffeinate
commands.description: Keeps the Mac awake while a process picked from the list runs.

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop Caffeinate
commands.subtitle: Caffeinate
commands.description: Stops the caffeinate session started by this extension.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Caffeinate — Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Caffeinate
commands.description: Shows caffeinate's status in the menu bar and lets you control it.

preferences.name: preventIdleSleep
preferences.title: caffeinate Flags
preferences.label: -i: prevent idle system sleep
preferences.description: If all three are unchecked, caffeinate applies -i by default.

preferences.name: preventSystemSleepOnAC
preferences.label: -s: prevent system sleep on AC power (even with the lid closed)

preferences.name: displayOffDelay
preferences.title: Display Off Delay
preferences.description: Seconds to wait before `pmset displaysleepnow`, so that releasing the Return key does not wake the display again (0 to 30).
